mapper.sql: id, paper_name, paper_no, total_score, duration, teacher_id, description, subject, difficulty, status, question_config, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.paper_name, p.paper_no, p.total_score, p.duration, p.teacher_id, p.description, p.subject, p.difficulty, p.status, p.question_config, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.deleted FROM paper p INNER JOIN teacher t ON p.teacher_id = t.user_id WHERE t.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper (paper_name, paper_no, total_score, duration, teacher_id, description, subject, difficulty, status, question_config) VALUES (#{paperName}, #{paperNo}, #{totalScore}, #{duration}, #{teacherId}, #{description}, #{subject}, #{difficulty}, #{status}, #{questionConfig})
